grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Lin's Study Goals and Habits
instructions: 请先阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有答案必须来自短文。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
Lin is a student at a small college in China. She studies English every day. She has a clear goal: she wants to pass the CET-4 exam next year. To reach her goal, she follows a simple study plan.

A. Morning Routine
Lin gets up at 6:30 every morning. She reads English aloud for twenty minutes. She usually listens to a short podcast while she eats breakfast. She says, “I always feel good after reading in the morning.”

B. After Class
Lin has classes in the afternoon. After class, she goes to the library. She often reviews her notes for one hour. Sometimes she does grammar exercises. She never studies late at night because she needs enough sleep. She believes that a good rest helps her learn better.

C. Weekend Practice
On weekends, Lin meets her study group. They practice speaking English together. They usually meet on Saturday morning. Lin’s friend, Wei, often brings a list of new words. They take turns asking and answering questions. Lin says, “We help each other and we have fun.”

D. Challenges and Advice
Lin sometimes finds listening difficult. She is now listening to English songs to improve. She also writes a short diary in English every evening. She advises other students: “Set a small goal first. Then do a little every day. Don’t wait for the perfect time.”

Lin is happy with her progress. She is not perfect, but she is trying her best. She knows that good habits lead to success.

options: To pass the CET-4 exam next year

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, never）连用。现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构为 be (am/is/are) + 动词-ing。do/does 用于一般现在时的疑问句和否定句。
grammar.example: She usually listens to a short podcast while she eats breakfast.

options: She is usually listen to music.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时，主语She是第三人称单数，动词listen要加-s。
questions.evidence: She usually listens to a short podcast while she eats breakfast.

questions.explanation: 一般现在时疑问句，主语she是第三人称单数，用does。
questions.evidence: She often reviews her notes for one hour.

questions.explanation: now表示现在进行时，结构为be + 动词-ing。
questions.evidence: She is now listening to English songs to improve.

questions.explanation: 根据短文，Lin从不在深夜学习，所以用never。
questions.evidence: She never studies late at night because she needs enough sleep.

part1: What do you do every day to study English?
Do you study in the morning or in the evening?

speaking.part2: Describe a study habit you have. You should say: what the habit is; when you do it; how it helps you; and explain why you keep this habit.
part3: Do you think good habits are important for learning? Why?
How can students improve their listening?

What advice would you give to a friend who wants to learn English?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 80 words) about your study habits. Use the present simple and frequency adverbs. Include: what you do every day, what you are doing now to improve, and one goal you have.
